purpose: These are AGI's own scenarios, not company disclosures. Each model starts from figures the company has filed (marked disclosed, with the document) and adds assumptions (marked, with a range and a reason) that you can change. Where no defensible anchor exists, the model waits for you rather than guessing. Materiality is measured against the company's filed FY26 EBITDA, so no forecast of total earnings is needed.

exitMultiple.label: Exit multiple
exitMultiple.rationale: AGI assumption for a mature earnings multiple; not a broker estimate.

limits: Scenarios, not forecasts or recommendations. No broker estimates are used. Contract models spread value evenly over the stated period; project revenue is lumpier. Where a company reports EBIT, EBITA or PBT instead of EBITDA, the model says which. Your changes stay in this browser.

marketSize.addedMWSource: JLL forecast (31 Aug 2026): 1.6 GW in mid-2026 to 6 GW by 2029; JLL does not say IT load.
marketSize.note: Per-MW figures are for each MW of IT load. The electrical and mechanical ranges come from a third-party blog's model, labelled by its authors as an assumption; AGI has not verified them. Replace any figure with your own. Layers are built not to overlap; an EPC or MEP contract figure (which bundles cables, panels and cooling) is not a layer, because adding it would count those twice.
